look_here_first: Look for a vigorous twining vine with large opposite cordate leaves, relatively large uniform olive-green star-shaped flowers, and a long smooth follicle with strong longitudinal angles.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers roughly 16–25 mm across in regional treatment

lookalikes.differences: Var. granulatus differs from var. suberosus in flower-color/appendage characters; unlike Matelea reticulata, it lacks the strongly reticulate corolla and muricate pod.
